name: Roquetas de Mar (Spain)
description: Divided by a wavy diagonal line from the lower hoist to the upper fly, blue above with a yellow sun in the hoist and white below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Roquetas de Mar (a tower on blue and white).
history: The flag of Roquetas de Mar is described as a rectangular silk or taffeta flag of 4:6, divided by a wavy line from the lower hoist to the upper fly, the upper part blue (sky) with a gold sun and the lower part silver (sea).

features.role: Roquetas de Mar arms — tower on blue and white
